question: 在相同几何、相同物理且移除追逐干扰后，哪种自动选钩策略最符合玩家意图，同时保持可信的松手动量？
coreAction: 按住自动挂钩并摆荡，松手完整保留切线速度飞出。

prototypes.name: 最近前向钩·基线
prototypes.hypothesis: 当前最近前向钩规则足够清楚，可作为控制组。
treatment: Use the exact shared fixture: 390x844, 1/120 fixed step, gravity 880, swing drive 190, attach radius 560, max speed 840, initial player (72,575) velocity (245,-185), eight anchors at x=275+325n with y=[365,335,375,330,370,340,365,335], finishX 2760 and failY 900.
Exclude anchors farther than 560 units or more than 20 units behind the player.
Choose the remaining anchor with the shortest Euclidean distance.
Capture current distance as rope length; release must preserve velocity exactly and add no impulse.

prototypes.name: 方向加权钩·意图优先
prototypes.hypothesis: 距离75%加飞行方向25%的选钩权重，会减少系统背叛感且不降低可读性。
treatment: Use the exact shared fixture: 390x844, 1/120 fixed step, gravity 880, swing drive 190, attach radius 560, max speed 840, initial player (72,575) velocity (245,-185), eight anchors at x=275+325n with y=[365,335,375,330,370,340,365,335], finishX 2760 and failY 900.
Exclude anchors farther than 560 units or clearly behind the current velocity vector.
Score eligible anchors using 75% normalized distance plus 25% angular error from current velocity; break ties by greater forward progress.
Capture current distance as rope length; release must preserve velocity exactly and add no impulse.

prototypes.name: 轨迹预判钩·截点优先
prototypes.hypothesis: 按180毫秒后的预测位置选钩，会更贴合高速飞行中的下一步意图。
treatment: Use the exact shared fixture: 390x844, 1/120 fixed step, gravity 880, swing drive 190, attach radius 560, max speed 840, initial player (72,575) velocity (245,-185), eight anchors at x=275+325n with y=[365,335,375,330,370,340,365,335], finishX 2760 and failY 900.
Exclude anchors farther than 560 units or clearly behind the current velocity vector.
Predict player position 180ms ahead and choose the eligible anchor nearest that point; break ties by greater forward progress.
Capture current distance as rope length; release must preserve velocity exactly and add no impulse.
